blocks.title: What Owners Are Buying
blocks.body: Owners evaluating Westin are buying a premium wellness-led full-service Westin brand backed by Marriott International distribution and Marriott Bonvoy. The practical case is Lead with wellness-led premium full-service fit—rooms, fitness, and wellbeing cues that owners can underwrite..

blocks.title: Premium Wellness Urban Conversion
blocks.body: Westin fits premium urban assets where wellness programming, rooms product, and calm public space can support higher-intent bleisure demand without forcing a W lifestyle or JW luxury capital stack.

blocks.body: Resort sites create Westin value when spa, fitness, and restorative guestroom design are capitalized as demand drivers—owners must price wellness operating intensity honestly against Sheraton or Marriott Hotels alternatives.

blocks.title: Owner Considerations
blocks.body: Sponsor capability, operator fit, and disclosure discipline matter more than flag prestige. Westin application, royalty, program contribution, and Bonvoy assessments — confirm current Marriott franchise / development fee exhibits. Amounts are not staged without a verified disclosure.

blocks.title: Standards-Protective Reflag
blocks.body: Reflags succeed when Heavenly-adjacent product cues and service culture stay brand-legible after cutover. Value fades if the PIP leaves a generic upscale box that guests cannot distinguish from sibling full-service brands.

blocks.title: Commercial Theme
blocks.body: Versus Sheraton's broader upper-upscale utility, Westin sells wellness and restorative product; versus lifestyle brands, it keeps a more standardized upper-upscale operating stack.
